cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before we discuss me moving out, can you check my train time again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. I've checked five times, and your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good. Does this ticket work at the barrier, or do I need the booking email?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through the barrier. Are you scared of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you're coming onto the platform, we need to check whether you need a ticket too.

mechanism: A uses increasingly exact professional corrections of practical matters to keep a vulnerable fear out of discussion.
confusable: Ordinary diligence differs from each solved detail becoming a new reason to avoid the emotional subject.
comparison: A scholarship letter hides fear of separation; a departure ticket hides fear of leaving a close person.
seedUse: Preserve B's helpful solutions and questions, letting A use the solutions to renew practical deflection.
